verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a way to stream step updates or model tokens from a running Hatchet workflow to an application frontend. The `hatchet tui` real-time observability is an operator terminal tool, not a frontend streaming API. The founder's mention of RabbitMQ 'streaming events between different workers' describes internal engine pub/sub, not consumer-facing progress streaming, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I stream live progress — step updates or model tokens — from a running workflow into my frontend as it executes
